newsitem.title: CHINA: China Jan-Oct aluminium output up 3.05 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China Jan-Oct aluminium output up 3.05 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's aluminium output totalled 1.4008 million tonnes from January to October, up by 3.05 percent compared with the same period last year, the China Securities said on Tuesday.
Aluminium production in October alone was 144,900 tonnes, the newspaper quoted a report issued by the State Statistical Bureau as saying.
China's alumina output totalled 2.0867 million tonnes in the first 10 months of 1996, up by 15.65 percent compared with the same period last year, it said.
Alumina production in October alone was 195,000 tonnes, it said.
